# Codex App Server schema baseline

These files are generated by Codex CLI 0.152.0 with:

```sh
codex app-server generate-json-schema --out DIR
```

They are provider-owned reference artifacts, not Agent Manager's public
protocol. Agent Manager's adapter intentionally speaks Codex's headerless
JSON-RPC-like wire format and maps it into the standard JSON-RPC 2.0 contract
under `protocol/broker/v1/`.

Run `mise run codex-schema` to refresh and checksum the curated bundle. The
script refuses any other CLI version so an upgrade must be an explicit contract
change.
